claims.head: Michkov’s line gets the soft minutes
claims.call: The Flyers’ L3 (Martone, Cates and Michkov) spends at least 27% of its 5-on-5 time against the Blue Jackets’ fourth line.
claims.body: At home, the Flyers keep sending Michkov’s line (Martone, Cates and Michkov) out against opponents’ fourth lines, far more often than chance would suggest. Rick Tocchet has been chasing an easier matchup for the team’s scorers. Tonight the Blue Jackets’ fourth line is Lomberg, Bel Belluz and Garland.
claims.nums: At home: 27% of this group’s 5-on-5 time against fourth lines, about 13% with no line matching
claims.gist: At home, Rick Tocchet likes to pick matchups, so watch who goes out against the Blue Jackets’ fourth line.

claims.head: The Blue Jackets’ edge in shots from defensemen
claims.body: The Blue Jackets are one of the league’s best for shots from defensemen, and the Flyers are near the bottom. It’s the widest gap between these two, though not a huge one.

notes.text: Ivan Provorov is on injured reserve (lower body injury) and has not played this season. He is a top-four defenseman. Zach Werenski has taken his spot beside Denton Mateychuk.
Damon Severson was added to the roster on Oct 24 and has played beside Zach Werenski.

The forward lines keep changing. Even their four most-used trios over the last 10 games cover only 24% of their forwards’ 5-on-5 time, the fourth-lowest in the league (a typical team: 43%). The lines listed lean on their latest games, but expect new combinations tonight.
Owen Tippett is on injured reserve and has missed the last 3 games. He is a top-six forward.
Cam York is on injured reserve (upper-body injury) and has missed the last 7 games. He is a top-four defenseman. Nick Seeler has taken his spot beside Jamie Drysdale.
Travis Konecny is on injured reserve and has missed the last 7 games. He is a top-six forward.

PHI.head: The Flyers start a half-step behind
PHI.body: Columbus has been out-chancing opponents lately, but Philadelphia has home-ice advantage. The Flyers can tip it if their power play gets going.

CBJ.head: Leaning the Blue Jackets’ way
CBJ.body: Columbus has been out-chancing opponents lately, but Philadelphia has home-ice advantage. Still, it’s close: the Flyers can make it interesting if their power play gets going.

story.head: Andrae returns to Philadelphia
paras: The Flyers have won three straight. The Blue Jackets are 3-5-0. Both teams are near the bottom of the standings.
At home, Rick Tocchet likes to pick matchups, so watch who goes out against the Blue Jackets’ fourth line. The Jackets have the edge over the Flyers on shots from defensemen.

items.text: Emil Andrae faces Philadelphia for the first time since leaving.
The Blue Jackets have been without Ivan Provorov all season.
The Flyers are newly without Owen Tippett, and have been without Cam York and Travis Konecny for several games.
Adam Fantilli has a point in five straight games against Philadelphia.
